title: Check Proxy Readiness
description: [Pathways Only] Check Proxy logs for readiness messages.
instruction: gcloud logging read 'resource.type="k8s_container" AND resource.labels.project_id="${project_id}" AND resource.labels.cluster_name="${cluster_name}" AND resource.labels.pod_name:"${jobset_name}-proxy-0" AND "IFRT proxy server started with status OK"' --project ${project_id} --freshness=${freshness}

freshness.description: gcloud log-read window. gcloud defaults to 1 day and returns an empty set with exit 0 for anything older, which reads as a real negative. Widen this to reach a historical incident.
